frames.physical_state_en: Same continuous hair tips are caught in the raised driver-window upper edge. Driver RIGHT hand approaches the single closed red scissors in her open lap bag.
frames.acting_en: Driver's brows draw together as her eyes track the taut hair tips and then the bag; concern without panic. Heroine watches the trapped strand neutrally. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.

frames.physical_state_en: Driver RIGHT hand briefly holds CLOSED scissors at low chest height, well away from hair and face. Window stays raised and hair caught.
frames.acting_en: Driver studies closed scissors with earnest, over-serious concentration; heroine looks from scissors toward the door switch with one lightly raised brow, no smirk. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.

frames.physical_state_en: Closed scissors are already inside the lap bag; driver RIGHT may rest on their handles there. Heroine RIGHT index points from her own side toward the outboard switch without touching it or crossing the driver torso.
frames.acting_en: Driver's eyes follow the heroine's short pointing direction to the outboard switch; scissors are already in bag. Heroine's gaze targets the switch, mouth neutral. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.

frames.physical_state_en: Driver LEFT index visibly contacts the actual far-screen-right outboard rocker; the glass is still raised and hair still caught. Scissors stay in bag.
frames.acting_en: Driver concentrates on the actual rocker under her LEFT index; slight brow tension remains because hair is not free yet. Heroine watches the same control. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.

frames.physical_state_en: Driver LEFT still presses the rocker. The same glass is descending and its top edge has cleared the same intact strand, which falls onto her shoulder; scissors remain in bag.
frames.acting_en: Driver's gaze follows the falling strand, eyebrows just starting to soften after release; no broad relief before the glass has moved. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.

frames.physical_state_en: Window has reached halfway down and stopped. Driver LEFT hand checks the same free strand on her shoulder; heroine RIGHT point has retracted into her own space.
frames.acting_en: Driver gently checks the freed intact strand, brow relaxed and shoulders less tense; heroine retracts her point into her own space with a calm face. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.

frames.physical_state_en: Hair remains intact and free, window halfway down, unused closed scissors in the open lap bag. Neither person reaches across the center.
frames.acting_en: Driver looks down at unused scissors in her lap bag, lips briefly pressed in mild embarrassment; heroine offers a tiny kind smile, not a laugh. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.

frames.physical_state_en: Heroine joins exactly two empty flat palms at lower sternum and bows forward over her own lap. Window, free hair and bag contents stay unchanged.
frames.acting_en: Heroine's eyes soften in her small forward seated bow; driver looks down toward unused scissors in her lap bag while her LEFT hand gently touches the freed strand, with a settled sheepish smile and hands in her own space. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.
